description: Roll dice using standard notation (e.g., '2d6+3', 'd20', '4d6'). Optionally use session RNG for determinism.

expression.description: Dice expression like '2d6+3', 'd20', '1d8-1'. No ability modifiers here: use roll_test for a character's roll.

sessionId.description: Optional session ID to use session RNG for determinism

name: roll_dice
